provenance.source_quote: back to power draw measurements with the z100 master. ive got it in parking mode, 4ch with the mini3x connected, collision detection mode. 12.6v. latest firmware that we updated to yesterday, same hardwire cable. idle: 44 mA recording: 935 mA

scope: Separate post-update owner 4CH collision-detection readings on Vortex Radar’s same test unit, with MINI3X connected and the same DC009 cable. Installed front/telephoto/4K rear/3K MINI3X cabin; active views per parking state are unreported. Owner says latest firmware updated yesterday; exact main/component versions are not established for this cohort. Cloud off belongs to the prior setup context and was not restated or independently verified after the update. Current is source-reported; watts derived exactly as 12.6 V × mA / 1000. No startup/wake timing, capture cadence, or isolated accessory consumption is established. Earlier 2CH and 4CH power/video records remain separate; these results do not establish a firmware power reduction.
firmware_qualifier: Owner reports latest firmware updated yesterday; exact updated version not established by an authoritative owner-unit update receipt. Not transferred to earlier power or video cohorts.

derivation: power_w = Decimal(voltage_v) * Decimal(current_ma) / Decimal(1000); source supplies current, not watts.
